label: Bookable beds that shut out of season

fields.name: part_lits_saisonniers
fields.label: Bookable beds open in season only

legend_note: Share of the commune's bookable beds that are campsite pitches, which in France shut out of season. Second homes are deliberately not in the denominator — they outnumber commercial beds several to one here and are usable in any season. A fact about the building stock, not about demand, which is why it can be stated per commune when nights cannot. Blank where nothing is bookable.

label: Summer season (department)
legend_note: Share of the DEPARTMENT's hotel nights falling in July–August, INSEE's monthly survey averaged over 2022–2025. Two months of twelve would be 17% with no season at all. Every commune carries its department's figure — this says where the commune is, not what the commune is.

label: Winter season (department)
legend_note: Share of the DEPARTMENT's hotel nights falling in December–March. Four months of twelve would be 33% with no season at all, so only values well above that mean a winter destination — Savoie and the Hautes-Alpes. Worth stacking against the 2050 heat and snow layers.

label: Seasonal peak (department)

fields.name: saison_hotel_amplitude
fields.label: Department's peak month vs a flat year

legend_note: The department's busiest month as a multiple of one twelfth of its year. 1.0 is the same traffic every month — Paris sits near it; 2.0 means a sixth of the year arrives in one month.
